info.title: ArchGuard personal Project daily Agent contract
info.description: Independent, default-closed daily advice contract. No runtime is registered by this contract. Explicit risk acknowledgement, bounded grant, Project selection and deployment gates are separate facts; none has default counts, cumulative spend or expiry. Advice never modifies deterministic findings, gates or CI. All writes require configured owner, current role, exact Origin and transport guards before parsing; service rechecks business authorization. All responses, including errors, are no-store. Schema structure does not prove authorization or cross-field/time business constraints.

x-archguard-json-rules: Parse canonical UUID, lowercase SHA-256 and RFC3339 instants strictly

Owner + Maintainer. Explicit bounded purposes/count/cumulative amount/expiry; current owner, Project, deployment, credential and binding. Service/database enforce maxCost<=maxAttempts*350000 and risk/evidence/price expiry. No defaults, Project auto-enable or provider call. State priority REVOKED, STOPPED, EXPIRED, EXHAUSTED, ACTIVE; active slot alone does not mean exhausted.

Configured owner + Viewer for explanation; PR summary also requires Maintainer. Authorize before body parsing and verify selected current Project resources. One grant has one active logical request; at most one attempt. Same-key replay recovers original snapshot even when grant expired/revoked; no new retrieval/dispatch. Cross-mode key collision or changed input=409. Failure/UNKNOWN stops grant; no retry. Queued does not imply a reservation.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exactly one configured same-origin value; owner and transport guards checked before reading the body.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: One visible ASCII key. Replay returns historical 200 without Location, extension, retrieval or scheduling; different original input is 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exactly one strong revision ETag within signed int64. Missing=428, stale=412, malformed=400.

Error.description: Stable sanitized API error. INVALID_INPUT=400; 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/DAILY_STATE_INVALID/DAILY_ACTION_IN_PROGRESS; 412 revision conflict; 428 missing If-Match; 429 QUOTA_EXHAUSTED; 503 MODEL_UNAVAILABLE. DAILY_STATE_INVALID has one sanitized message; authorized context/grant carries detail. Cross-Project resources are hidden as 404. Preserve the existing ApiError including details.
